abilities.name: Attention Seekers
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick the closest enemy unit to it to be the target. If 2 or more enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. During that move, this unit can move into combat and can pass through models in the target unit, but it must end that move within 1/2" of the target. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.

abilities.name: Ruptured Cysts
abilities.declare: Pick a visible Diseased enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each other Diseased enemy unit within 3" of the target. If the chanting roll is 9+, you can also pick a friendly Plaguebearers unit within 12" of the target. For each enemy Infantry model slain by this ability this turn, you can return 1 slain model to that friendly unit.

abilities.name: Scry the Filth
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Wizards while they are within 3" of this unit. • Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Priests while they are within 3" of this unit.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Bilespurter's Claws is 3.

abilities.name: Daemon Flies
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Miasma of Pestilence
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, other than the Companion ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that friendly unit have no effect.

abilities.name: Utter Defilement
abilities.declare: This unit's Pestilent Pollutants are tokens. This unit has 2 Pestilent Pollutants. Pick an objective or terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place 2 of this unit's Pestilent Pollutants next to the target. If both of this unit's Pestilent Pollutants are already on the battlefield, pick 1 of them, remove it from the battlefield and place it next to the target instead.

abilities.name: From the Tainted Earth
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 3" of: • An objective or terrain feature that has a friendly Pestilent Pollutant, or • A Polluted terrain feature (see Gelgus Pust's 'Master Contaminator' ability), or • An objective you control

abilities.name: Entropy Endures
abilities.effect: If this unit has 2 models and would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, 1 model in this unit is slain.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Gathoblyt's Fanged Maw is 3.

abilities.name: Vile Poisons and Debilitating Toxins
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. You cannot pick a Manifestation or terrain feature.
abilities.effect: You and your opponent must roll off. Add this unit's Control characteristic to your roll and the target's Control characteristic to your opponent's roll. If your roll is higher, apply the corresponding effect: • If the target is a Hero or Monster, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between your roll and your opponent's roll. • If the target is a non-Hero non-Monster unit, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: Annelid Engorgement
abilities.effect: For each enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn and was destroyed this turn, this unit gains D3 leech points for the rest of the battle. Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to this unit's Control characteristic for each leech point it currently has.

abilities.name: The Leechlord's Curse
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: This unit gains 1 leech point for the rest of the battle. Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a Core ability or command, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any damage points were allocated to the target by this ability, Heal (1) this unit.

units.name: Gelgus Pust, the Prince of Sores

abilities.name: Parasitic Infestation

abilities.name: Polluting Aura

While an enemy unit is within 6" of a Polluted terrain feature, each time that unit uses or is the target of an ability that would heal 1 or more damage points, subtract 1 from the number of damage points healed, to a minimum of 0.

abilities.name: Master Contaminator
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is considered by you to be Polluted for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Knell of Doom

abilities.effect: Roll a D3. If the target is within 6" of a friendly Sloven Knights unit, you can roll a D6 instead. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.effect: Roll D3. On 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.declare: Pick this unit and a friendly Putrid Blightkings unit within 3" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn

abilities.name: Sevenfold Slaughter

abilities.name: Lord of the Infected Legions

abilities.name: Mire Kelpies

In addition, your opponent cannot give that Priest any ritual points for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: Putrescent Piety
abilities.effect: This unit has Priest (1) for the rest of the battle.

abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, give this unit D3 ritual points.

abilities.name: Tainted Sorceries
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was picked to be the target of a spell that was successfully cast by this unit this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Cloying Quagmire
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: • Halve the target's Move characteristic. • If the target's Save characteristic is 3+ or better, subtract 1 from run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

abilities.name: Fleshy Abundance
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects: • Heal (D3) the target. • Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Bloated with Sickness
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-Monster Maggotkin of Nurgle unit wholly within 12" of the chanter to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to the target in each phase, If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

abilities.name: Gift of Disease
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Priest to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with the chanter. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, each enemy unit in combat with the chanter, excluding Manifestations and terrain features, has the Diseased keyword.

abilities.name: Favoured Poxes
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the chanter to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 2 from charge rolls for the target, If the chanting roll was 10+, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1, instead.

abilities.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
